title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Schedule of Monthly Service Fees and Occupancy by Apartment Type
content:
Under the Independent Living Residency Agreement (rental model), Larkspur Senior Living publishes the following monthly service fees and occupancy terms for each independent living apartment type. All amounts are in US dollars per calendar month.

## Schedule

| Apartment type | Published base monthly service fee (single occupancy) | Second person fee | Maximum occupants |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 3,285.00 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 3,968.00 | 1,045.00 | 2 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 4,412.00 | 1,045.00 | 2 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 5,147.00 | 1,120.00 | 2 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 5,693.00 | 1,120.00 | 2 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 6,478.00 | 1,195.00 | 2 |

Plain figures for reference: Studio 3285.00, One-Bedroom 3968.00, One-Bedroom Deluxe 4412.00, Two-Bedroom 5147.00, Two-Bedroom Deluxe 5693.00, Cottage Home 6478.00; second person fee 0.00, 1045.00, 1045.00, 1120.00, 1120.00 and 1195.00 in the same order.

## Age terms

| Apartment type | Minimum age of the first resident (on the planned move-in date) | Minimum age of a second occupant (on the day the second occupant moves in) |
|---|---|---|
| Every apartment type, Studio through Cottage Home | 62 years | 55 years |

## Notes to the schedule

- The published base monthly service fee is the fee for an apartment type at single occupancy when a residency agreement is newly contracted or an apartment transfer is made.
- The second person fee is added for each calendar month a second occupant shares the apartment. A figure of 0.00 means a second occupant is not permitted in that apartment type: the Independent Living Studio is single occupancy only.
- The maximum number of occupants is a count of persons: one for the Studio and two for every other apartment type.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustrations)

- A couple sharing an Independent Living Two-Bedroom at a newly contracted agreement would see a published base monthly service fee of 5,147.00 and a second person fee of 1,120.00 for a full calendar month.
- A single resident in an Independent Living Cottage Home has no second person fee in a month in which no second occupant shares the cottage.
